text_block_list.name: TV News Anchor
text_block_list.text:
"The time has finally come once again this 
year! Held at Nakayama Racecourse amidst 
the refreshing green breeze, the first leg 
of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki 
Sho—"

text_block_list.name: TV News Anchor
text_block_list.text:
“The traditional Classic race that can 
only be challenged once in a lifetime is 
about to begin! Before the race, let's 
review the competing Umamusume!”

text_block_list.name: TV News Anchor
text_block_list.text:
"First up is this Umamusume! Full of 
energy and unmatched stamina, the 
festival-loving girl, Kitasan Black!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"To be able to run in a Classic race is 
like a dream! I'm so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just like Teio-san, whom I admire so 
much... I want my running to bring joy and 
courage to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support! Let's do this! 
Wasshoi!

text_block_list.name: TV News Anchor
text_block_list.text:
"Next up is undeniably one of the top 
favorites! Young lady of the Satono Group, 
the elite Umamusume, Satono Crown!"

text_block_list.name: TV News Anchor
text_block_list.text:
"Racking up steady wins since the Junior 
class, she radiates a presence that could 
easily make her the center of her 
generation."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Dàjiā hǎo! I'm Satono Crown. Finally, 
our... no, *my* Classic race is about to 
begin.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The Satono Group's first-ever GⅠ 
victory... That will be achieved in the 
Satsuki Sho. —Under the name of Satono 
Crown!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gentlemen, get your hopes up 
high! Today's victor will be—me, Satono 
Crown!

text_block_list.name: TV News Anchor
text_block_list.text:
"And we mustn't forget that Umamusume who 
also commanded so much attention even 
before her debut!"

text_block_list.name: TV News Anchor
text_block_list.text:
" 'Born into a distinguished family of 
athletes, she aims for the world just like 
those before her. Her name is—' "
(Waaaaaaah!!)

No matter how many times I come here, this 
sheer intensity never fails to astound me. 
That is just how much prestige and 
expectation the Classic races carry.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's started again this year! Last year's 
race had such an interesting development.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! With such a powerhouse lineup 
this year, I doubt there'll be many 
upsets.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"My vote's on Satono Crown! After seeing 
that brilliant, overwhelming victory in 
the last race, you really realize an elite 
is just built different!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of elites, what about Duramente?! 
That supreme running I saw at the Kyodo 
News Hai... I want to see it again!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I've come here many times as a spectator. 
I know this frenzy well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Being surrounded by that same level of 
passion felt good. However...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Today's voices aren't embracing me. It 
feels almost as if...—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...No. It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...No, damn it. Focus.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The strongest. An overwhelming, absolute 
strongest. A flawless victory. ...A 
victory—

The way Duramente is walking right now... 
Is she fired up and focused, or is she—

She seems more keyed up than ever before. 
I understand how she feels. Being who she 
is, she'd likely still produce results 
even in her current state, but—
choice_data_list_en: ï¼â¦â¦No good, she can't hear me.ï¼

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I want to win with style.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—I want to run in a way that makes me feel 
like the strongest... and win the race of 
my dreams.

—I want her to challenge this 
once-in-a-lifetime race in the way she 
desires. How can I first reach her with my 
words as she is now...? Thinking—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: 終わったら“新メニュー”だな！
終わったら“新メニュー”だね！
choice_data_list_en: Once we're done, it's time for the "new menu"!
Once we're done, we get the "new menu"!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: A new menu?
choice_data_list: I'll think up a training menu!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Why now? It's right before the race.
choice_data_list: トレーニングメニューを考えるんだよ
choice_data_list_en: I need to put together a training routine.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't be thinking about what comes 
after.
choice_data_list:
Because is there really anything else to 
think about?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: There should be plenty.
choice_data_list: だって他に、考えることがある？
choice_data_list_en: I mean, is there anything else to think about?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
What must be done to secure an 
overwhelming victory—
choice_data_list: There's no need to think about it, right?

There's no need to think about it, is 
there?

text_block_list.text:
The magnificent blood of athletes flows 
through Duramente's veins. That blood 
gifted her with exceptional talent.
choice_data_list: 考えなくてもいいだろ？
考えなくてもいいでしょう？
choice_data_list_en: You don't really have to think about it, right?
You don't really have to think about it, do you?

text_block_list.text:
"Yet she never grew complacent, continuing 
to put in the work. Possessing both talent 
and dedication—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...I see. That is true..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
As the one destined to claim victory 
today... I stand here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "I swear on this blood. ...Yes, exactly."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. Your words are truly 
reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...You said that after the Kyodo News 
Hai... you would shout my name."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "Try calling it out right now, as a test."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"……Being so formal makes me feel kind of 
ticklish."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I believe in that.
choice_data_list: 俺はこの声を必ず届ける
私はこの声を必ず届ける
choice_data_list_en: I will make sure this voice reaches you.
I will make sure this voice reaches them.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: If I believe... I can reach it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Phew—
(Waaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(It's overwhelming. This massive roar from 
the crowd... it feels like it's crushing 
me.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Trembling... feeling like I'm about to be 
swallowed whole.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(In the middle of this... will Trainer's 
voice really reach me...?)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ......No. Believe in it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Trust in "me." —Trust in the person I 
chose.)
